subject: Internet stopped working
body: Customer lost internet connectivity. Router restart did not resolve the issue.
resolution: Network outage was confirmed and service was restored.

subject: Slow internet connection
body: Customer reported very slow internet performance.
resolution: Router diagnostics identified a connection problem.

subject: Unknown billing charge
body: Customer reported an unfamiliar charge on the latest invoice.

subject: Password reset email missing
body: Customer could not reset the account password because the reset email was not received.
resolution: Customer verified the email address and the reset process was completed.

subject: Suspicious login
body: Customer reported an unfamiliar login notification.
resolution: Security team reviewed the account and secured access.
